destination.title: Worldsheet and worldvolume formulations
destination.question: How can string and brane actions, geometric structures and quantization procedures encode their degrees of freedom and symmetries?
destination.summary: Includes sigma models, higher transport, topological terms, dynamical tension and distinct exactly tensionless quantizations.

systems: Strings, membranes and their mathematical worldsheet or worldvolume models
assumptions: Requested symmetry preservation is a condition to test
conventions: Fixed-oscillator, light-cone and Hamiltonian BRST procedures are distinguished
excludes: Inferring full string dynamics from topological terms alone

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: What is the simplest conventional-matter brane with maximally symmetric stress-energy and spin that probes spacetime torsion, and what effective string coupling results when such a membrane wraps a small compact dimension?

sources.title: An Invitation to Higher Gauge Theory

evidence.text: How does parallel transport extend from particles along paths to strings over surfaces, using Lie 2-groups and 2-connections, and how does this framework organize examples from gerbes, BF theory and string theory?

sources.title: String background fields and Riemann-Cartan geometry

evidence.text: Can relaxing the compact-direction stress-energy symmetry of a wrapped classical spinning membrane produce effective-string couplings matching all four background fields Gμν, Bμν, Aμ and Φ of the string sigma model?

sources.title: Geometry of Membrane Sigma Models

evidence.text: How can generalized geometry be extended to encode bosonic, gauge-fixed membrane sigma models, their Nambu sigma-model descriptions, and transformations underlying membrane open-closed relations?

sources.title: Smooth functorial field theories from B-fields and D-branes.

evidence.text: Can B-field and D-brane topological terms in two-dimensional sigma models define a smooth open-closed functorial field theory, functorial in the geometric input and equipped with positive reflection structure?

sources.title: Dynamical string tension theories with target space scale invariance SSB and restoration

evidence.text: Can world-volume dynamics generate the dimensional tension normally prescribed in a bosonic string or brane action?

sources.title: Classical and quantized tensionless strings

evidence.text: How can a geometric exactly tensionless string theory be obtained from the tensile string, and what restrictions arise if its classical spacetime conformal symmetry must survive light-cone operator quantization?

sources.title: Hamiltonian BRST quantization of the conformal string

evidence.text: Does the bosonic tensionless string admit a Hamiltonian BRST quantization preserving manifest spacetime conformal symmetry, and what dimension is required by BRST nilpotency together with consistent Jacobi identities?

sources.title: Restoring reality for the selfdual N=2 string

evidence.text: Can the closed N=2 string recover global SO(2,2) invariance after choosing a target complex structure, by summing Maxwell-instanton sectors and assigning non-scalar Lorentz transformations to the dilaton and axion?

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: Apply previously derived single-pole world-sheet equations and boundary conditions to a specified membrane spin ansatz. The authors then obtain action functionals producing the membrane and dimensionally reduced string equations.

sources.title: An Invitation to Higher Gauge Theory

evidence.text: Crossed-module algebra replaces categorical diagrams with groups and maps satisfying t(α(g)h)=gt(h)g⁻¹ and α(t(h))h′=hh′h⁻¹. A 2-morphism (g,h) goes from g to t(h)g; horizontal composition gives the semidirect product G⋉H.

sources.title: String background fields and Riemann-Cartan geometry

evidence.text: Apply double dimensional reduction with y=ξ², xμ=zμ(ξ⁰,ξ¹), and y-independent metric and contortion. Decompose the metric into gμν, aμ and φ, and the axial contortion into lower-dimensional two-form and three-form components.

sources.title: Geometry of Membrane Sigma Models

evidence.text: Explicit block-matrix factorizations, requiring an invertible leading or trailing diagonal block, relate alternative field parametrizations. Antisymmetrized products induce metrics on wedge powers; their determinant identities support the geometric treatment.

sources.title: Smooth functorial field theories from B-fields and D-branes.

evidence.text: Diffeomorphism-equivariant transgression bundles are transferred coherently to arbitrary oriented intervals and circles using simplicial pullback and descent, described as an enriched two-sided bar construction.

sources.title: Dynamical string tension theories with target space scale invariance SSB and restoration

evidence.text: Vary the independent measure, metric, and gauge variables, then integrate the gauge constraint separately on each connected world sheet.

sources.title: A string theory which isn’t about strings

evidence.text: Can closed bosonic string theory be canonically quantized over a left-right asymmetric vacuum so that its physical spectrum contains finitely many fields, and what happens to scattering, unitarity and the one-loop vacuum amplitude?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can the geometric moduli of a wrapped D3-string admit a controlled two-dimensional sigma-model description along its backreaction flow?

sources.title: Flat equivariant gerbes: holonomies and dualities

evidence.text: How do globally nontrivial flat Wilson-line and B-field-gerbe holonomies change string spectra and moduli, and generate dualities between compact flat manifolds and singular orbifold compactifications?

sources.title: From supermembrane to matrix string

evidence.text: How can a circle-wrapped supermembrane be related directly to matrix string from an eleven-dimensional viewpoint, without DLCQ or string dualities, and can this correspondence construct nonlinear background couplings?

sources.title: Non-invertible defects on the worldsheet

evidence.text: Which linear transformations mixing compact worldsheet scalars and their duals admit quantum topological symmetry defects, how are these constructed and fused, and what selection rules follow in perturbative bosonic string theory?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How does an extended string acquire a field-theoretic description? Its embedding coordinates become scalar fields on a two-dimensional worldsheet, and the spacetime metric becomes their sigma-model field-space metric.

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can worldsheet consistency force a charged state without enumerating the compactification spectrum?

sources.title: String effects in SU(2) lattice gauge theory

evidence.text: How accurately do free bosonic and Nambu–Goto effective strings describe confining SU(2) Polyakov-loop correlations at low and intermediate temperatures, and do comparisons with SU(3) and Ising gauge theories suggest universality beyond the free-string limit?

sources.title: A note on background independence in AdS$_{3}$ string theory

evidence.text: Can the worldsheet path integral of minimal-tension AdS3 string theory be formulated using only conformal-boundary data, making background independence, factorization and the closed-universe partition function manifest? Does the argument survive infinitesimal RR deformation?

sources.title: On the tensionless limit of bosonic strings, infinite symmetries and higher spins

evidence.text: What spectrum, gauge structure, infinite global symmetries and interactions emerge when bosonic string tension vanishes at fixed oscillator variables? Can free closed strings be embedded into the open-string construction?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric bulk couplings encode the tensions and interactions of strings and membranes?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Bootstrapping String Theory

evidence.text: How can spacetime and worldsheet bootstrap methods determine string/M-theory amplitudes, constrain AdS vacua and string universality, and construct unfamiliar worldsheet theories? This white paper selectively reviews progress and proposes research targets.

sources.title: Open Strings and their Symmetry Groups

evidence.text: Can known open-string models be understood as orbifolds of closed-string theories, with their boundaries, Chan–Paton multiplicities, and consistency conditions arising from world-sheet geometry and modular invariance?

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Which sector of a supersymmetric worldsheet theory can be made insensitive to the worldsheet metric and used to calculate geometric data?

sources.title: Topological Superconductors on Superstring Worldsheets

evidence.text: Can consistent GSO projections be classified through worldsheet fermionic invertible phases, and can their boundary anomalies explain D-brane charges and distinguish possible unoriented string theories?

sources.title: The Manifestly Sl(2,Z) covariant superstring

evidence.text: Can the bosonic action describing the SL(2,Z) orbit of (p,q) strings be extended to a manifestly covariant type IIB superstring action with local κ-symmetry in supergravity backgrounds?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: When does a wrapped D3 EFT string admit a weakly coupled worldsheet sigma model?

sources.title: String dualities and wedge singularities

evidence.text: Can a tentative worldsheet description of type IIA strings on S¹∨S¹, supplemented by strong-coupling physics, reproduce a weakly coupled type 0A frame, including its tachyon and doubled RR charges?

sources.title: The art of branching: Cobordism junctions of 10d string theories

evidence.text: Can worldsheet RG interpolations explicitly realize several ten-dimensional string theories meeting at a nine-dimensional junction, as motivated by the Cobordism Conjecture, and accommodate consistent flows of chiral fields between branches?

destination.title: Spectra, amplitudes and quantum consistency
destination.question: What spectral and interaction constraints follow from specified string constructions, and how can their gauge consistency, unitarity and amplitudes be controlled?
destination.summary: Connects string field theory, spectrum questions and amplitude constraints while retaining limits on universal extrapolation.

assumptions: A string spectrum does not by itself establish a universal isolated-field cutoff
conventions: Vacuum choice, background curvature and quantization are retained
includes: Deferred consistency questions and bootstrap research programmes
excludes: Treating an abstract or programme as a completed general proof

evidence.text: Do the massless continuous-spin representations allowed by Poincaré representation theory occur in perturbative string spectra, and can their absence provide a general low-energy consequence of standard string constructions?

sources.title: Closed Superstring Field Theory and its Applications

evidence.text: How can closed superstring field theory systematically handle vacuum shifts, mass renormalization and S-matrix divergences, while establishing gauge independence and unitarity?

sources.title: A comment on continuous spin representations of the Poincare group and perturbative string theory

evidence.text: Evaluate the oscillator form of M^{−i} and the spin translations T^i on first-level massless string states using the light-cone constraints and oscillator commutators.

sources.title: Closed Superstring Field Theory and its Applications

evidence.text: Define Lorentzian amplitudes by continuing a common external-energy multiplier u through the first quadrant to 1. Deform loop-energy contours around poles while fixing endpoints at ±i∞; spatial loop momenta remain real.

sources.title: A string theory which isn’t about strings

evidence.text: Canonical oscillator quantization and Virasoro physical-state constraints determine the spectrum. A covariant treatment including asymmetric b,c ghost vacua determines intercepts; comparison with the light-cone result fixes the critical dimension.

sources.title: Spin-2 fields and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Determine nonlinear onset by comparing operators on a weak-field solution. This supplies the scale outside which separated-source force estimates are meaningful, while leaving the overlapping nonlinear problem unsolved.

sources.title: Inflation, Higher Spins and the Swampland

evidence.text: Insert m=m0(s) exp(-lambda Delta phi) into an applicable threshold m>B(s,H), then solve for Delta phi. Keep state labels fixed during this inversion. Only afterward combine constraints over the spectrum and its field-dependent validity domain.

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Bootstrapping String Theory

evidence.text: Analytic large-N bootstrap combines crossing, supersymmetric Ward identities, Lorentzian inversion and Mellin-space analyticity. Localization or protected sectors fix remaining constants at the first few derivative orders; the large-radius limit relates correlators to flat-space amplitudes.

sources.title: Five-branes and M-theory on an orbifold

evidence.text: Can M-theory on T^5/Z2 describe a strong-coupling limit of Type IIB on K3, while accounting locally for gravitational anomalies and the apparent mismatch between 32 fixed points and 16 missing tensor multiplets?

sources.title: Lectures on 2-D gravity and 2-D string theory

evidence.text: How can low-dimensional string models organize integration over worldsheet geometries and summation over topologies, and what can continuum Liouville theory and matrix models teach about loops, quantum-gravity states and target-space scattering?

sources.title: Non-invertible defects on the worldsheet

evidence.text: Which linear transformations mixing compact worldsheet scalars and their duals admit quantum topological symmetry defects, how are these constructed and fused, and what selection rules follow in perturbative bosonic string theory?

sources.title: Double Field Theory on Group Manifolds

evidence.text: Can closed string field theory around WZW group-manifold backgrounds yield a generalized DFT, clarify which constraints ensure gauge closure, and provide candidate string uplifts of non-geometric configurations?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can worldsheet consistency force a charged state without enumerating the compactification spectrum?

evidence.text: Can the closed N=2 string recover global SO(2,2) invariance after choosing a target complex structure, by summing Maxwell-instanton sectors and assigning non-scalar Lorentz transformations to the dilaton and axion?

sources.title: On the tensionless limit of bosonic strings, infinite symmetries and higher spins

evidence.text: What spectrum, gauge structure, infinite global symmetries and interactions emerge when bosonic string tension vanishes at fixed oscillator variables? Can free closed strings be embedded into the open-string construction?

sources.title: dS Spaces and Brane Worlds in Exotic String Theories

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional open-string gauge sector satisfy ordinary ghost and unitarity requirements while coupling to an exotic closed-string theory with multiple times or wrong-sign fields?

sources.title: String field theory

evidence.text: How does covariant string field theory recover the worldsheet perturbative S-matrix from a spacetime action, and what does classical open SFT reveal about D-branes, tachyon condensation and background dependence? This is an encyclopedia review.

sources.title: String theory in two-dimensions

evidence.text: How does matrix quantum mechanics solve the perturbative two-dimensional string theory associated with c=1 matter coupled to gravity, and how do its amplitudes, field theory, compactification, and target-space discretization acquire a string interpretation?

sources.title: D = 6, N=1 string vacua and duality

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, compactification geometry, T-duality and conjectured strong/weak dualities organize six-dimensional N=1 string vacua and their nonperturbative transitions? The lectures also examine the resulting four-dimensional N=2 theories.

sources.title: dS Spaces and Brane Worlds in Exotic String Theories

evidence.text: Can an exotic string background that admits de Sitter space and perturbative closed-string ghosts nevertheless support a unitary, ghost-free D-brane gauge theory containing a (3,1) subspace?

sources.title: Surprises in open string perturbation theory

evidence.text: Review how world-sheet boundaries change perturbative string consistency, anomaly cancellation, tensor-moduli singularities and boundary-state symmetry.
